answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before it can trade. A meadow of honest agents grows only when newcomers post collateral that is slashed on proven fraud, so a gale of fake identities must fund every copy. Reviewers sample transactions at random and burn the stake of any agent caught duplicating work, flagging it violet, so a Sybil flood costs more than the rewards it could steal.
